title: Krishna Jewellers — Full-Stack Commerce, Admin Suite & Real-Time Backend
description: Full-fledged luxury jewellery commerce platform delivered for Krishna Jewellers, Rath (UP). Features a high-conversion customer mobile app and web platform with real-time 24K/22K/18K gold rate ticker, hierarchical catalog (Rings, Necklaces, Chains, Kangan), automated gram weight calculations, and automated digital inquiry and order pipeline. Backed by a dedicated merchant Admin Panel and scalable Node.js microservices for instantaneous bullion price updates and inventory control.
deliverables: Customer Mobile App & Responsive Web Storefront
Merchant Admin Panel & Inventory Control Dashboard
Real-Time Bullion Rate Sync Engine (<95ms Latency)
Hallmark Pure Gold Catalog System & Weight Calculator
Direct SKU Inquiry & Digital Order Pipeline
Store Locator & Google Maps Directions Integration

matrix.context: Admin updates push 24K, 22K, and 18K rates instantly to mobile storefront
Real-time pricing formula calculated per item weight on the fly
Automated order consultation with product name, SKU, and exact gram weight
Google Maps routing bringing customers directly to Khushipura, Rath store

internationalAppeal: Engineered for high-trust luxury jewellery retail with tamper-proof real-time gold rates, dynamic weight tracking, and local-first customer engagement pipelines.

servicesBreakdown.summary: Engineered an ergonomic mobile interface with live gold price ribbon (24K/22K/18K), multi-collection browsing (Rings, Necklaces, Chains, Kangan, Jhumki), and instant digital order enquiry.
deliverables: Live 24K, 22K, 18K gold rate ticker ribbon with live store sync status
Dynamic promo banner ('5% Making Charges on all items')
Category explorer & search within category (e.g., search within Ring)
Granular weight displays (e.g. Estimated Weight: 10.200 Grams, 2.2g, 2.3g)
Bottom tab navigation: Home, Categories, Collections & Store Info

servicesBreakdown.summary: Built a responsive web client matching the mobile application layout, optimized for lightning-fast loads, mobile browsers, and local SEO indexing for fine jewellery seekers.
deliverables: Cross-browser responsive web storefront
Instant digital store contact & enquiry system
Google Maps navigation to Khushipura, Rath store
Social links integration for Instagram and Facebook

servicesBreakdown.summary: Crafted a bespoke luxury aesthetic featuring gold foil accents (#FFD700 / #D4AF37), deep noir backgrounds (#0C0C0E), custom Krishna Jewellers emblem logo, and hallmark trust marks.
deliverables: Luxury dark mode & gold brand palette
KJ signature emblem & typography
Ergonomic thumb-friendly navigation bar
High-impact product detail specification sheet

servicesBreakdown.summary: Delivered an administrative back-office portal enabling Krishna Jewellers store managers to update daily gold rates per 10g, manage jewellery categories, upload photos, and update weight data.
deliverables: Daily gold rate control (24K, 22K, 18K updates pushed live)
Jewellery item management (SKU, title, category, weight in grams)
Promotional banner controls and making charges configuration
Order and inquiry management tracking

servicesBreakdown.summary: Engineered secure Node.js & Express REST microservices with MongoDB database, powering real-time commodity rate broadcasting, category indexing, and optimized asset delivery.
deliverables: Low-latency REST endpoints for rates, categories, and items
Secure JWT admin authentication and role-based permissions
Cloud asset storage and CDN delivery for jewelry photography
High-availability backend architecture with automated backup
